sources.quote: 8.7.1.1 A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.
BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).

findings.why: BR-220 is supplied to STL. The proposed temporary deviation falls under STL requirement 8.7.1.1, so it needs STL approval through the supplier portal before any shipment. No approval in force is in the documents. The request is within PRC-DEV-007 limits (1,800 pieces against a maximum of 2,000, and 5 weeks against a maximum of 6) and includes 100% fastener hole inspection. Filing is decided by the Plant Quality Manager.
